description: This file contains helper functions for testing the gateway component, including functions to connect/disconnect clients, start gateway server, and handle WebSocket communication with device authentication.

methods.name: getFreeGatewayPort
methods.description: Returns a deterministic free port for the gateway.

methods.name: connectGatewayClient
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the gateway as a client with specified parameters.

methods.name: connectDeviceAuthReq
methods.description: Performs device authentication request over WebSocket, including challenge nonce handling and signing.

methods.name: startGatewayWithClient
methods.description: Starts a gateway server and connects a client, returning server details and client instance.
